title: Activities
text:
Activities at Sifti Ghar
At Sifti Ghar, we offer a wide range of activities that let you experience the authentic rural lifestyle of Punjab. Whether you’re looking for adventure, relaxation, or cultural immersion, there’s something for everyone.


Farm Life Experiences

Livestock Rearing, Milking, and Butter Making
Get hands-on with farm animals, learn how to milk cows, and try your hand at making fresh butter.
Photo Suggestion: A family or group of visitors milking cows or churning butter in a traditional setting.
Feeding Animals and Agricultural Work
Help feed the animals and participate in daily farm chores like sowing, harvesting, or tending to crops.
Photo Suggestion: Visitors feeding goats, cows, or chickens, or working in the fields.
Fodder Cutting and Crop Cutting
Experience the traditional methods of cutting fodder and harvesting crops.
Photo Suggestion: Visitors using traditional tools to cut crops or fodder, with lush green fields in the background.




Adventure and Fun

Camel and Horse Rides
Enjoy a leisurely ride on a camel or horse, exploring the farm and surrounding landscapes.
Photo Suggestion: Visitors riding camels or horses with scenic farm views in the background.
Bull Cart, Jeep, and Cycle Rides
Take a nostalgic ride on a bull cart, explore the farm on a jeep, or cycle through the picturesque countryside.
Photo Suggestion: A bull cart ride with a family, or a group of friends cycling through the farm.
Tractor Pulling and Trolley Back Competitions
Test your strength and teamwork in fun tractor-pulling competitions.
Photo Suggestion: Visitors participating in a tractor-pulling competition, laughing and enjoying the activity.




Cultural Celebrations

Lohri and Basant Panchami Festivals
Join us in celebrating Punjab’s vibrant festivals with bonfires, music, dance, and traditional food.
Photo Suggestion: A bonfire during Lohri, with people dancing and singing, or colorful kites flying during Basant Panchami.
Music Nights and Light Shows
Unwind under the stars with live music performances and mesmerizing light shows.
Photo Suggestion: A stage with live musicians performing, or a light show illuminating the night sky.




Games and Competitions

Rural Games
Play traditional games like maze-solving, kite flying, rope pulling, kabaddi, and kho-kho.
Photo Suggestion: Visitors flying kites, playing kabaddi, or solving a maze in a playful setting.
Fine Arts and Crafts
Participate in live painting competitions or explore fine crafts created by local artisans.
Photo Suggestion: Visitors painting on canvases or admiring handmade crafts.




Special Experiences

Photography and Marriage Photoshoots
Capture your special moments against the stunning backdrop of our farm. Perfect for pre-wedding or family photoshoots.
Photo Suggestion: A couple posing for a photoshoot in the fields, with golden sunlight in the background.
School Visits
Educational trips for students to learn about farming, sustainability, and rural life.
Photo Suggestion: A group of school children participating in farm activities, with a teacher guiding them.





Why Choose Sifti Ghar?
Our activities are designed to give you a true taste of rural Punjab while creating lasting memories. Whether you’re a nature lover, adventure seeker, or culture enthusiast, Sifti Ghar has something special for you.

title: Sifti Ghar - Agro-Ecotourism
Welcome to Sifti-Ghar
text:
Welcome to Sifti Ghar – Where Nature Meets Culture
If deserts (sand) can attract tourists, why not the lush green farm landscapes of Punjab?
At Sifti Ghar, we invite you to escape the chaos of city life and immerse yourself in the serene beauty of rural Punjab. Experience the charm of agro-ecotourism, where breathtaking farm landscapes, authentic culture, and hands-on farming activities come together to create unforgettable memories.

Discover Sifti Ghar
Sifti Ghar is more than just a destination – it’s a journey into the heart of Punjab’s agricultural heritage. Our project is designed to bring the farm life of Punjab to life, offering visitors a unique blend of relaxation, education, and adventure.

Experience Authentic Rural Punjab – Explore working farms, lush fields, and traditional Punjabi culture.

Try Your Hand at Farming – Get involved in farm activities and connect with the land.

Savor Organic Delights – Enjoy fresh, organic produce straight from our farms.

Celebrate Local Traditions – Participate in vibrant festivals and cultural events.



Our Mission
At Sifti Ghar, our mission is to bridge the gap between people and nature. We aim to foster a deep appreciation for agriculture, sustainability, and the beauty of rural life. Through education, entertainment, and hands-on experiences, we create a welcoming space for learning, adventure, and connection.
Our Core Values:
- Sustainability – Protecting and preserving the environment.
- Community – Celebrating and supporting local culture and traditions.
- Education – Inspiring a love for agriculture and the natural world.


Explore Nearby Attractions
Sifti Ghar is perfectly located near some of Punjab’s most iconic landmarks:
- Attari-Wagha Border (The Famous International Border with Pakistan) – Just 200 meters away.
- Golden Temple, Amritsar – 32 KM
- Durgiana Mandir, Amritsar – 28 KM
- Gobindgarh Fort, Amritsar – 28 KM
- Jallianwala Bagh – 32 KM
- Sham Singh Attari Museum, Attari – 3 KM
- Pul Kanjri – 7 KM
- Punjab State War Heroes’ Memorial & Museum – 19 KM


Plan Your Visit
Ready to experience the tranquility and charm of rural Punjab? Book your stay at Sifti Ghar today and embark on a journey that will rejuvenate your mind, body, and soul.
